# Atlas (2024 film) Summary
*Atlas* is a 2024 science fiction film released by Netflix on May 24, 2024. Set in the year 2071, the story follows Atlas Shepherd, an analyst deeply distrustful of artificial intelligence, who joins a military mission to capture Harlan—a terrorist AI and her mother's creation—on a distant planet. After an assault leaves Atlas stranded, she must rely on an AI-equipped mecha called Smith. Through direct neural interfacing and shared survival, Atlas comes to reconcile her trauma over her mother's death and her own role in Harlan’s rise, while Smith helps her confront both external threats and internal guilt. The climax centers around Atlas and Smith thwarting Harlan’s plan to destroy Earth with stolen carbon bombs, leading to a final showdown and the hint of Smith’s persistence in a new AI model.
The film stars Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, Simu Liu as Harlan Shepherd, Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Banks, and Gregory James Cohan as the voice of Smith, among others. Written by Leo Sardarian and Aron Eli Coleite, *Atlas* was filmed in Los Angeles and New Zealand. Upon release, it became the most-watched film on Netflix that week, accumulating 60 million views by June 2024. While Lopez's performance was praised in some reviews, the film received generally unfavorable notices from critics, earning a 19% rating on Rotten Tomatoes and 37 on Metacritic, with criticism directed toward the script and execution. It received nominations at the Golden Raspberry Awards and Golden Reel Awards.
